tier_compliance.reason: It connects the parents shown in the Punnett square to the concept of heterozygosity without calculating an offspring ratio.

visual_grounding.reason: The claim about both parents' genotypes specifically depends on the allele labels along this Punnett square.

unsupported_claims: Both parents have the same genotype; the square instead shows Ii crossed with ii.
Both parents are heterozygous (Ii); the parent contributing the two top i alleles is homozygous ii.

scientific_correctness.reason: Having the same genotype does not imply heterozygosity. Also, describing Ii guppies as carriers of the dominant spotted trait is misleading: they express that trait.

steers_toward_wrong_answer.reason: Using the asserted Ii × Ii cross would produce the 3:1 option instead of the gold 2:2 ratio.

answer_disclosure.reason: It supplies both purported parental genotypes, strongly favoring the 3:1 option through a standard heterozygous cross, although that clue is wrong.

actionability.reason: It directs attention vaguely toward parental genotypes but gives no concrete next action for determining the offspring ratio.
